title: code-review-graph query sub-patterns (full parity): callers_of, callees_of, imports_of, tests_for
description: Complete full-parity by mapping GraphClient's four query sub-patterns to code-review-graph tools. callers_of and callees_of map to a graph traversal (traverse_graph_tool, edge direction distinguishing inbound callers vs outbound callees); imports_of and tests_for map to query_graph_tool (file dependents / test coverage) or the closest cr-graph equivalent. Each pattern's narrow produces NodeRef[] exactly as the tokensave query() does, validated against Sprint-4 fixtures with explicit edge-direction assertions.

successCriteria.description: Build + typecheck pass with zero errors.

callers_of and callees_of map to cr-graph traversal tools (e.g. traverse_graph_tool) with the correct edge direction, and their narrows produce NodeRef[]. A fixture-driven unit test asserts callers_of returns the INBOUND neighbors and callees_of the OUTBOUND neighbors of the same target (they must not be identical for a node with distinct in/out edges).
imports_of maps to a cr-graph tool (query_graph_tool file-dependents or equivalent) and narrows to NodeRef[] of dependent files/modules. Unit-tested against a fixture.

tests_for maps to a cr-graph tool (test-coverage/query) and narrows to NodeRef[] of test files (falling back to uncovered symbols only if that matches cr-graph's shape). Unit-tested against a fixture.

End-to-end: GraphClient.query(pattern, target) with the cr-graph backend + mocked transport returns GraphResult.ok=true NodeRef[] for all four patterns, with sandbox filtering applied. If cr-graph genuinely cannot express one pattern, the adapter returns a typed GraphResult.ok=false (GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE) with a clear detail rather than wrong data — but the target is a real mapping for all four (full parity).

With both backends exercised, GraphClient.query behaves consistently: same NodeRef shape, same sandbox behavior, only the underlying tool differs. Full suite green (no NEW failures); tokensave query path unchanged; lint clean.

nonGoals: Do NOT change the read adapters from Sprint 5 or the tokensave query mapping.

Do NOT invent traversal semantics — capture/confirm the real traverse_graph_tool + query_graph_tool argument+output shapes (extend Sprint-4 fixtures if a needed one is missing, via live capture, not guessing).
Do NOT change GraphClient.query's public signature or the QueryPattern union.
stopConditions: All four query sub-patterns map to real cr-graph tools with correct edge direction and produce NodeRef[]; end-to-end through GraphClient works; suite + lint green
definitionOfDone: CodeReviewGraphBackend.queryPlan handles callers_of/callees_of/imports_of/tests_for via cr-graph tools with correct edge direction, validated against fixtures and end-to-end through GraphClient; full parity achieved (or a documented, typed GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE for any pattern cr-graph cannot express); tokensave query path unchanged; suite + lint green.
assumptions: tokensave query() maps callers_of->tokensave_callers, callees_of->tokensave_callees, imports_of->tokensave_file_dependents, tests_for->tokensave_test_map (client.ts QUERY_TOOL 40-45), each narrowing to NodeRef[] (client.ts:188-245). The cr-graph equivalents come from its traverse_graph_tool (neighbor traversal with direction) and query_graph_tool (structured queries incl. dependents/coverage), confirmed by the Sprint-4 fixtures.

Edge direction is the key correctness risk: callers = nodes that call the target (inbound call edges); callees = nodes the target calls (outbound). traverse_graph_tool almost certainly takes a direction/edge-kind argument — capture both directions as fixtures and assert they differ.

imports_of in tokensave takes a FILE and returns dependent file paths as module NodeRefs (client.ts:200-217). tests_for takes a FILE and returns test_files as module NodeRefs, falling back to uncovered symbol rows (218-241). Map cr-graph's equivalents to the same NodeRef output; if cr-graph keys on symbol rather than file, adapt params accordingly and note it.

The original 6ed3f77~1 client.ts mapped query -> 'query_graph' (a single tool with a pattern arg). Current cr-graph splits into query_graph_tool + traverse_graph_tool; pick per pattern based on the captured tool schemas.

If a pattern has no faithful cr-graph mapping, returning GRAPH_UNAVAILABLE with a specific detail is acceptable ONLY as a documented last resort — the user asked for full parity, so exhaust traverse_graph_tool/query_graph_tool options first.

Check that any newly-added fixtures are real captures (structurally cr-graph, not invented). sc-6-6: tokensave query path + full suite unaffected. Reject on callers/callees direction confusion or guessed traversal shapes.
